manifest_row.title: Fundraiser aims to raise profile of island's erosion problem

screening.main_topic: A fundraiser to publicize Tangier Island’s erosion and challenge President Trump’s reassurance about climate change and sea-level rise.
screening.climate_relevance: The report connects the island’s erosion and sea-level rise to a public dispute over climate change, making climate impacts and political debate central to its account.
screening.reason: Although the fundraiser is the immediate news event, it is explicitly intended to counter the president’s position on climate change and draw attention to the island’s erosion problem in the context of reported sea-level rise.
